D: Agent J travels back to 1969 to save a young Agent K from an alien assassin.
P: Serve dessert when young K and J stop for pie at the diner.
S: Grilled franks in soft buns with yellow mustard and warm sauerkraut
Franks grilled until split, in soft buns with mustard and sauerkraut, wrapped in wax paper.
Steamed pork, prawn and ginger dumplings
Pork and prawn dumplings steamed in bamboo baskets for 8 minutes, with soy and chilli oil.

Cheddar, cream cheese and spring onion rolled into a ball, coated in chopped walnuts, served with crackers. Beat 250g softened cream cheese with 200g grated vintage cheddar, 2 finely sliced spring onions, 1 tsp Worcestershire and a pinch of cayenne until smooth. Shape into a ball, wrap in cling film and chill for 2 hours until firm. Roll in 80g finely chopped toasted walnuts mixed with chopped parsley. Sit on a board and serve with 200g crackers and celery sticks.
M: Launch day cheeseburgers and crinkle fries
the Apollo 11 launch at Cape Canaveral

Beef patties grilled to medium, cheddar melted on, in toasted buns with lettuce, tomato and onion, with crinkle fries. Bake 1kg frozen crinkle-cut fries at 220C for 25 minutes. Shape 600g beef mince into 4 patties a little wider than the buns and season well. Grill on high heat 3 to 4 minutes a side for medium, adding a slice of cheddar for the last minute. Toast 4 burger buns. Spread with mayo and tomato sauce and build with lettuce, sliced tomato, thin onion rings, pickles and the patty. Serve with the fries.
Beef meatloaf glazed with tomato sauce and brown sugar
Beef meatloaf with onion and breadcrumbs, glazed with tomato sauce and brown sugar, baked at 180C for an hour, with mash and peas.
W: Cinnamon green apples under a lattice crust
Apples cooked with butter, sugar and cinnamon, baked in shortcrust with a lattice top at 190C for 45 minutes, served warm with ice cream.
K: Vodka, coffee liqueur and strong espresso shaken ice cold

Vodka, fresh espresso and coffee liqueur shaken hard with ice until a thick crema forms, strained into chilled glasses with three coffee beans. Chill 4 martini glasses in the freezer. Make 4 shots of strong espresso or 200ml very strong coffee and cool for 5 minutes. Shake 2 drinks at a time: 90ml vodka, 60ml coffee liqueur, 100ml espresso and 1 tbsp sugar syrup with a big scoop of ice, shaking hard for 20 seconds. Strain into the glasses and float 3 coffee beans on the foam. For non-drinkers, shake espresso with syrup and milk over ice.

s.note: Grilled franks in soft buns with yellow mustard and warm sauerkraut
s.how: Warm 300g sauerkraut in a small pan with a pinch of caraway seeds. Grill 8 hot dog franks until they split. Tuck into soft buns, add a stripe of yellow mustard and a pile of sauerkraut, then wrap each in wax paper like a boardwalk stand.

s.note: Steamed pork, prawn and ginger dumplings
s.how: Mix 250g pork mince with 150g chopped green prawns, grated ginger and a splash of soy. Fill dumpling wrappers and pleat closed. Steam in a lined bamboo basket for 8 minutes. Serve hot with soy sauce and chilli oil for dipping.

m.note: Beef meatloaf glazed with tomato sauce and brown sugar
m.how: Mix 800g beef mince with a grated onion, a cup of breadcrumbs, an egg and salt. Press into a loaf tin and spread with tomato sauce mixed with brown sugar. Bake at 180C for an hour. Serve thick slices with buttery mash from 1kg potatoes and peas.

w.note: Cinnamon green apples under a lattice crust
w.how: Cook 6 sliced green apples with 50g butter, 100g brown sugar and a teaspoon of cinnamon until just soft, then cool. Line a pie dish with shortcrust, fill and weave a lattice on top. Bake at 190C for 45 minutes and serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

Strain into the glasses and float 3 coffee beans on the foam. For non-drinkers, shake espresso with syrup and milk over ice.
